theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_facts_requires_current_authority

theorems.name: M5Authority.new_opens_no_quota
theorems.claim: A newly constructed authority has no quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.new_opens_no_quota : ∀ (profile : noble_kernel.authority.Profile) (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.new profile = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok s) → ↑s.quotas = []

theorems.name: M5Authority.new_starts_within_quota
theorems.claim: Initialization: a new authority satisfies the quota invariant.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.new_starts_within_quota : ∀ (profile : noble_kernel.authority.Profile) (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.new profile = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok s) → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s

theorems.name: M5Authority.step_preserves_quota_within
theorems.claim: Preservation: every public state-returning transition preserves the quota invariant.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.step_preserves_quota_within : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.Step s s' → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.reachable_quota_within
theorems.claim: Over every finite serialized prefix of public transitions from Authority.new, each checkpoint-local quota record stays within its supplied snapshot.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.reachable_quota_within : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.Reachable s → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s

theorems.name: M5Authority.advance_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: Checkpoint advancement changes neither table nor any ledger counter.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.advance_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (checkpoint : noble_kernel.authority.Checkpoint) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result Unit noble_kernel.authority.SetupError), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.advance_from_trusted_host s checkpoint = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.authorize_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: Authorization appends exactly one live witness and counts it, or changes neither table nor any ledger counter.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.authorize_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (outcome : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Authorization), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.authorize_from_trusted_host s plan current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_counts
theorems.claim: A committed admission sets both admission counters to one more than before and leaves the creation and protected-operation counters unchanged.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_counts : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → s'.counters.witnesses_created = self.counters.witnesses_created ∧ ↑s'.counters.attempts_admitted = ↑self.counters.attempts_admitted + 1 ∧ s'.counters.witness_consumptions = s'.counters.attempts_admitted ∧ s'.counters.protected_operations = self.counters.protected_operations

theorems.name: M5Authority.admission_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: Admission consumes one live witness, registers one unstarted attempt and counts both, or on denial and preflight changes neither table nor any ledger counter.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.admission_moves_ledger : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (outcome : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove self s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: A start marks one unstarted attempt started and counts one protected operation, or changes nothing.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.start_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.permit.Started noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.start_execution s execution = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.observe_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: An observation rewrites at most the observed attempt record, keeping its key, plan and start flag, and moves no ledger counter.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.observe_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (description : noble_kernel.authority.report.ObservationDescription) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.report.Observation noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.observe_from_trusted_host s description = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.retire_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: Witness retirement rewrites only a live witness, to Retired; a consumed or retired witness is refused without change.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.retire_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result Unit noble_kernel.authority.permit.Denial), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.retire_witness s witness = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.retireIfLive_eq_self
theorems.claim: Retiring live witnesses leaves any non-live record unchanged.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.retireIfLive_eq_self : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.authority.WitnessRecord), record.state ≠ noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Live → M5Authority.retireIfLive record = record

theorems.name: M5Authority.retire_live_witnesses_effect
theorems.claim: The generated live-witness retirement loop terminates, rewrites exactly the live records to Retired and changes neither the attempt table nor the counters.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.retire_live_witnesses_effect : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.retire_live_witnesses s = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok s' → ↑s'.witnesses = List.map M5Authority.retireIfLive ↑s.witnesses ∧ s'.attempts = s.attempts ∧ s'.counters = s.counters

theorems.name: M5Authority.cancel_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: Invocation cancellation retires every live witness and changes nothing else in the ledger, or changes nothing.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.cancel_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.report.InvocationOutcome noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.cancel_invocation s = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.fail_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: Invocation failure retires every live witness and changes nothing else in the ledger, or changes nothing.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.fail_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.report.InvocationOutcome noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.fail_invocation s = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.deliver_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: Success delivery retires every live witness and changes nothing else in the ledger, or changes nothing.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.deliver_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (attempt : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AttemptKey) (observed : noble_kernel.authority.report.Observation) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.report.Receipt noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.deliver_success s attempt observed = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.step_moves_ledger
theorems.claim: Every public state-returning transition is one of the ledger moves.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.step_moves_ledger : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.Step s s' → M5Authority.LedgerMove s s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.countP_set_keeps
theorems.claim: Replacing a list element by one with the same predicate value keeps the count.
theorems.statement: @M5Authority.countP_set_keeps : ∀ {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) (i : ℕ) (old new : α), l[i]? = some old → p new = p old → List.countP p (l.set i new) = List.countP p l

theorems.name: M5Authority.countP_set_adds
theorems.claim: Replacing an element failing the predicate by one satisfying it adds one to the count.
theorems.statement: @M5Authority.countP_set_adds : ∀ {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) (i : ℕ) (old new : α), l[i]? = some old → p old = false → p new = true → List.countP p (l.set i new) = List.countP p l + 1

theorems.name: M5Authority.countP_map_retire
theorems.claim: Retiring live witnesses keeps the number of consumed witnesses.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.countP_map_retire : ∀ (l : List noble_kernel.authority.WitnessRecord), List.countP M5Authority.isConsumed (List.map M5Authority.retireIfLive l) = List.countP M5Authority.isConsumed l

theorems.name: M5Authority.ledger_move_preserves_consistency
theorems.claim: Every ledger move preserves the agreement of the tables with the ledger counters.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.ledger_move_preserves_consistency : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.LedgerMove s s' → M5Authority.LedgerConsistent s → M5Authority.LedgerConsistent s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.new_starts_ledger_consistent
theorems.claim: Initialization: a new authority has empty tables and zero counters, so they agree.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.new_starts_ledger_consistent : ∀ (profile : noble_kernel.authority.Profile) (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.new profile = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok s) → M5Authority.LedgerConsistent s

theorems.name: M5Authority.step_preserves_ledger_consistent
theorems.claim: Preservation: every public transition keeps the tables and the ledger counters in agreement.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.step_preserves_ledger_consistent : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.Step s s' → M5Authority.LedgerConsistent s → M5Authority.LedgerConsistent s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.reachable_ledger_consistent
theorems.claim: Over every finite serialized prefix of public transitions from Authority.new: consumed witnesses equal registered attempts in number, protected operations count exactly the started attempts, and the creation and admission counters count their tables.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.reachable_ledger_consistent : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.Reachable s → M5Authority.LedgerConsistent s

theorems.name: M5Authority.ledger_move_preserves_settled_witnesses
theorems.claim: No ledger move rewrites a witness record that has left Live.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.ledger_move_preserves_settled_witnesses : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.LedgerMove s s' → ∀ (i : ℕ) (record : noble_kernel.authority.WitnessRecord), (↑s.witnesses)[i]? = some record → record.state ≠ noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Live → (↑s'.witnesses)[i]? = some record

theorems.name: M5Authority.ledger_move_keeps_started_attempts
theorems.claim: Every ledger move keeps a started attempt started, with its key and plan.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.ledger_move_keeps_started_attempts : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.LedgerMove s s' → ∀ (i : ℕ) (record : noble_kernel.authority.AttemptRecord), (↑s.attempts)[i]? = some record → record.started = true → ∃ record', (↑s'.attempts)[i]? = some record' ∧ record'.started = true ∧ record'.key = record.key ∧ record'.plan = record.plan

theorems.name: M5Authority.settled_witness_is_never_rewritten
theorems.claim: Once a witness leaves Live, no finite sequence of public transitions rewrites its record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.settled_witness_is_never_rewritten : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), Relation.ReflTransGen M5Authority.Step s s' → ∀ (i : ℕ) (record : noble_kernel.authority.WitnessRecord), (↑s.witnesses)[i]? = some record → record.state ≠ noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Live → (↑s'.witnesses)[i]? = some record

theorems.name: M5Authority.consumed_witness_never_returns_to_live
theorems.claim: Denial, preflight, retirement and every other transition cannot resurrect consumed authority: a consumed witness stays consumed over every finite trace.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.consumed_witness_never_returns_to_live : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), Relation.ReflTransGen M5Authority.Step s s' → ∀ (i : ℕ) (record : noble_kernel.authority.WitnessRecord), (↑s.witnesses)[i]? = some record → record.state = noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Consumed → ∀ (record' : noble_kernel.authority.WitnessRecord), (↑s'.witnesses)[i]? = some record' → record'.state = noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Consumed

theorems.name: M5Authority.started_attempt_stays_started
theorems.claim: A started attempt stays started, with its key and plan, over every finite sequence of public transitions.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.started_attempt_stays_started : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), Relation.ReflTransGen M5Authority.Step s s' → ∀ (i : ℕ) (record : noble_kernel.authority.AttemptRecord), (↑s.attempts)[i]? = some record → record.started = true → ∃ record', (↑s'.attempts)[i]? = some record' ∧ record'.started = true ∧ record'.key = record.key ∧ record'.plan = record.plan

theorems.name: M5Authority.started_attempt_never_starts_again
theorems.claim: Attempts start at most once over every trace: once started, no finite sequence of public transitions reaches a state in which the same execution permit starts the attempt again.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.started_attempt_never_starts_again : ∀ (s s' s'' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), Relation.ReflTransGen M5Authority.Step s s' → ∀ (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution) (record : noble_kernel.authority.AttemptRecord), (↑s.attempts)[↑execution.attempt.slot]? = some record → record.started = true → ∀ (started : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Started), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.start_execution s' execution ≠ Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok started, s'')
